entries.16586155d7d09a61: With the vision “Want to Come Back to Japan,” the company aims to increase the number of people around the world who want to return to Japan, by eliminating inconveniences experienced by inbound travelers and foreign residents living in Japan during their stays and by building a service platform that enables more comfortable stays. In the medium to long term, it intends to expand its business by leveraging customer touchpoints built since its founding, centered on inbound visitors and foreign residents, by resolving inconveniences foreigners experience in Japan and responding to newly emerging needs; it says it will focus on strengthening marketing, developing more convenient systems, and raising repeat rates in the Mobile Network and Camper Van businesses, and on expanding the referral service area in the Life Mediatech Business.
